entry.summary: Tourists can visit up to 30 days without a visa.
entry.max_stay: 30 days; extensions applied for within the first 14 days

money-and-cost.cash_card_notes: The local currency is the Lesotho Loti (LSL). South African Rand (ZAR) is widely accepted. Credit and debit cards are accepted in major centres for payments and at ATMs. If you are travelling outside Maseru, take enough cash (Loti or Rand) to cover local purchases. Ask your bank if your cards will work in Lesotho. Cash or traveller’s cheques in any currency valued at 25,000 LSL or more must be declared. consular.notes: Australia doesn't have an embassy or consulate in Lesotho. You can get consular assistance from the Australian High Commission in Pretoria, South Africa.

laws.rule: To drive in Lesotho, you need both: a valid Australian driver's licence (digital driver's licences may not be accepted) an International Driving Permit (IDP) You must obtain your IDP before departing Australia.
